title: Equivariance reflected through inverse-image units
statement: Let $i:Y_0\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $M$ any abelian group, $G=\underline M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $G_0=i^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $T_1,T_2$ be $G$-torsors and $R_1,R_2$ be $G_0$-torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Let $L$ be set-sheaf inverse image and let $e_j:L(T_j.\mathrm{sheaf})\simeq R_j.\mathrm{sheaf}$ satisfy $e_j(\eta_{T_j}(g+\!_v t))=\eta_G(g)+\!_v e_j(\eta_{T_j}(t))$ over every base-changed étale object, for every coefficient section $g$ and torsor section $t$. Suppose $L$ is injective on the Hom set from $T_1.\mathrm{sheaf}$ to $T_2.\mathrm{sheaf}$. If $f:T_1.\mathrm{sheaf}\to T_2.\mathrm{sheaf}$ and an equivariant sheaf map $\varphi:R_1.\mathrm{sheaf}\to R_2.\mathrm{sheaf}$ satisfy $L(f)e_2=e_1\varphi$, then $f$ is equivariant. No finiteness assumption or equivalence of finite étale categories is required.

source.place: Tag 0A5G, final paragraph; Tag 03RV for finite representability. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A5G and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03RV.

proof.text: Let η be toSheafify from the constant presheaf M to G and let c_U(m)=η_U(m). Naturality of η gives G(k)c_U(m)=c_V(m). Thus translation by c_U(m) defines a natural endomorphism a_j(m) of T_j.sheaf, using T_j.map_vadd.

Compare L(a₁(m)≫f) and L(f≫a₂(m)) after postcomposition by e₂.hom. Apply injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence. Unit naturality for a₁(m), f, a₂(m) rewrites their adjoints. The equality L(f)≫e₂.hom=e₁.hom≫φ gives the unit square hs. Evaluate at an arbitrary W,t; use compatibility he₁, equivariance of φ, compatibility he₂, and hs to show the values equal. Cancel e₂.hom, then apply injectivity of L.map to obtain a₁(m)≫f=f≫a₂(m). All these transformations are explicit in the Lean proof.

For an arbitrary g in G(U), the image sieve of η on g covers U because the sheafification unit is locally surjective (Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify). On each arrow k:V→U in this sieve choose m with c_V(m)=G(k)g. Naturality of f and both torsor actions reduce the equivariance equation after restriction to V to evaluation of a₁(m)≫f=f≫a₂(m). Separatedness of the sheaf T₂ on this covering sieve gives the original equality. Empty covers and the zero group are included.

proof_origin.place: Categorical details of the finite étale torsor argument in Tag 0A5G, formalized by X2.

theorem torsor_map_equivariant_of_unit
    {Y Y₀ : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y₀ ⟶ Y)
    (M : Type (u + 1)) [AddCommGroup M]
    (T₁ T₂ : Sheaf.Torsor
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M)))
    (R₁ R₂ : Sheaf.Torsor ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))))
    (e₁ : (Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj T₁.sheaf ≅ R₁.sheaf)
    (e₂ : (Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj T₂.sheaf ≅ R₂.sheaf)
    (he₁ :
      let G := (constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of M)
      (∀ (W : Y.Etale) (g : G.obj.obj (op W)) (t : T₁.sheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
      e₁.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (u + 1))
          (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
          (Y₀.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app T₁.sheaf).hom.app (op W)
            (T₁.vadd (op W) g t)) =
      R₁.vadd (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
        (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).unit.app G).hom.app
          (op W) g)
        (e₁.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Y₀.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app T₁.sheaf).hom.app (op W) t))))
    (he₂ :
      let G := (constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of M)
      (∀ (W : Y.Etale) (g : G.obj.obj (op W)) (t : T₂.sheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
      e₂.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (u + 1))
          (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
          (Y₀.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app T₂.sheaf).hom.app (op W)
            (T₂.vadd (op W) g t)) =
      R₂.vadd (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
        (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).unit.app G).hom.app
          (op W) g)
        (e₂.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Y₀.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app T₂.sheaf).hom.app (op W) t))))
    (f : T₁.sheaf ⟶ T₂.sheaf)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun k : T₁.sheaf ⟶ T₂.sheaf ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).map k))
    (φ : R₁.sheaf ⟶ R₂.sheaf)
    (hφ : ∀ U g t, φ.hom.app U (R₁.vadd U g t) =
      R₂.vadd U g (φ.hom.app U t))
    (hf : (Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).map f ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ φ) :
    ∀ U g t, f.hom.app U (T₁.vadd U g t) = T₂.vadd U g (f.hom.app U t)
